title: The Restaking Mesh
description: Shared security as a 3D mesh: one pool of restaked ETH, operators who each extend that single stake to several AVSs, and the correlated slashing it creates. Slide the overlap, then tap an operator to slash it and watch every service it backs lose collateral at once.
controls: slide overlap k — services each operator secures with its one stake
tap an operator to slash it and trace the correlated blast radius
tap an AVS to see how many operators back it and how many it shares
